Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that may help instantly relieve back pain off to one side.

This exercise will focus on two separate movements that well help offer a deep stretch from the upper back, into the ribs and lower back. It may give pain and muscle tightness relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
